supersedes: v3 independent DOT3 test failed false-feasible gate; its labels are excluded from this fit and test
data_role: new registered microbenchmarks and synthetic operation mixtures; formal/holdout PPA excluded

train.topology: one through four products, serial reduction and independent addends

validation.topology: two through four products with per-branch addends before reduction

test.topology: two through four products with unequal branch depths and balanced reduction

source_group: whole source bundle and every mapping/SDC variant; each split has distinct primitive widths and combination topology
fit: nonnegative base scale/intercept/operation-count/result-bit terms, delay and area separately; fit train only; validation determines multiplicative delay margin using its maximum underprediction ratio times 1.05, with floor at 1; no independent-test labels used
feasibility_budget_definition: multiples of measured Q-D label for classification evaluation only; never an input feature
support: bounded unsigned Mul/Add/AddCarry single-output DAGs with independent primary inputs; no masks, literals, correlated operands, wide division or FP; unsupported stage composition must be rejected
boundary: H=T-QD-slack includes clkQ/setup/skew/uncertainty once; capture control path and engineering reserve separately accounted
